screen.radialmenu.config.title: Radial Configuration
screen.radialmenu.config.show_preview.to: Renders a live preview of your radial menu that updates as you change settings, including the invisible detection zones.
screen.radialmenu.config.optimize.toolti:
When you change a 'Submenu' or 'Macro' slot to another mode, its nested slots or macro actions are kept saved in the background.

This button permanently deletes all of that hidden, unused submenu and macro data to optimize memory and shrink your config file size.

WARNING: This action is irreversible. This is the only way to completely reset and clear submenu and macro data for a slot.
screen.radialmenu.config.slot_count.tool: The number of selectable slices in the radial menu.
screen.radialmenu.config.slot_radius.too: The distance from the center of the screen to the center of every item slot and the center line of the visible radial menu.
screen.radialmenu.config.radial_thicknes: Controls the thickness of the visible radial menu. The ring expands equally inward and outward around the slot radius.
screen.radialmenu.config.inner_detection: Extends the invisible selection area inward beyond the visible radial menu. This does not move the slots or sectors.
screen.radialmenu.config.outer_detection: Extends the invisible selection area outward beyond the visible radial menu. This does not move the slots or sectors.
screen.radialmenu.config.background_colo: The default color of the unselected menu sectors.
screen.radialmenu.config.activation_colo: The color a sector uses when actively hovered or selected.
screen.radialmenu.config.border_color.to: The border color used by unselected sectors.
screen.radialmenu.config.highlight_borde: The border color used by highlighted sectors.
screen.radialmenu.config.show_activation: Renders the visible background ring and sector colors behind the item slots.
screen.radialmenu.config.draw_outer_bord: Draws the curved accent borders along the inside and outside edges of the visible radial menu.
screen.radialmenu.config.draw_sector_bor: Draws an accent border on the straight edges dividing each menu slice.
screen.radialmenu.config.sector_border_w: Controls the thickness of the inner and outer arc borders of the sector ring.
screen.radialmenu.config.sector_gap.tool: The visual spacing between each slice. This is purely cosmetic and does not affect the clickable hitbox area.
screen.radialmenu.config.enable_backgrou: Smoothly blurs the background when opening the radial menu, matching the reveal animation.
screen.radialmenu.config.title_text.tool: Title text shown between the edit-mode button and the radial menu.
screen.radialmenu.config.title_color.too: Color and opacity of the top title text.
screen.radialmenu.config.center_hint_lin: First line shown in the center disc when no slot is hovered.
Second line shown in the center disc. Leave empty to show only line 1, centered.
Color and opacity of the first line of the center hint text.
Color and opacity of the second line of the center hint text.
screen.radialmenu.config.bottom_hint_col: Color and opacity of the bottom confirm/back hint text.
screen.radialmenu.config.reveal_animatio: Controls how the radial menu appears when opened.
screen.radialmenu.config.reveal_duration: The total amount of time used to reveal the radial menu. Staggered animations overlap while still completing within this duration.
screen.radialmenu.config.enable_hover_an: Moves and scales the hovered slot outward when the cursor enters it.
screen.radialmenu.config.hover_animation: Controls how quickly a slot moves and scales when hovered. Set to 0 for instant movement.
screen.radialmenu.config.activation_mode:
How actions are triggered.

Cursor + Click: Aim with the mouse, activate by clicking.
Cursor + Release: Aim with the mouse, activate by letting go of the hotkey.
Scroll + Click: Select with the scroll wheel, activate by clicking.
Scroll + Release: Select with the scroll wheel, activate by letting go of the hotkey.
screen.radialmenu.config.reset_cursor_on: Resets the cursor to the center of the screen when opening a submenu.
screen.radialmenu.config.radial_size.too: Scales the overall size of the radial menu.
radialmenu.ui.hint_confirm_back: Left-Click / Release %s = Confirm  ·  ESC / Right-Click = Back
